C1475.title: Itron-Centron CL200 Smart Meter Node Impersonation Attack
C1475.summary: An attacker physically captured an Itron-Centron CL200 smart meter, analyzed its EEPROM memory dump, and discovered that the device ID is stored locally without read/write protection. By copying another meter's ID into the EEPROM, the attacker made the compromised device impersonate a different smart meter, leading to energy consumption data theft.
